extensions.name: Card Timer
extensions.summary: Use an optional target countdown during review without automatic grading.
extensions.description: Shows a configurable target timer beside each review card. Reaching zero only announces that the target elapsed; it never reveals, grades, or reschedules a card. The extension has no content or network access, and stores only its enabled state and duration in synchronized configuration.

extensions.name: Memory Insights
extensions.summary: Inspect current collection workload and organization without mastery claims.
extensions.description: Provides read-only collection metrics, deck counts, common tags, due-today context, and content-health signals in a sandboxed page. Metrics describe the current collection and do not claim to measure mastery. The extension has no write or network access.

extensions.name: NeoAnki TTS
extensions.summary: Generate, cache, and play provider-backed text-to-speech audio while studying in NeoAnki.
extensions.description: Generate and cache review audio with configurable profiles, batch processing, and live playback. Supports OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, and Azure Speech. Prompt text is sent directly to the provider you select; API credentials stay in the operating system's secure credential storage and are not synchronized. Provider accounts and usage charges may apply.
